newsitem.title: FRANCE: World vehicle production down 0.6 pct in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: World vehicle production down 0.6 pct in H1 1996.

text.p: Worldwide motor vehicle production totalled 26.11 million units in the first half of 1996, down 0.6 percent from the year earlier period, the International Organisation of Motor Vehicle Manufacturers (OICA) said on Thursday.

Car production totalled 18.71 million units, down 0.6 percent, the Paris-based organisation said in a statement. Car production in the NAFTA countries -- Canada, Mexico and the United States -- fell by 6.1 percent.
Light truck output rose 2.3 percent to 6.17 million units, of which 60 percent was in North America.
Heavy truck production fell 15.2 percent to 1.03 million.
"Total motor vehicle exports reached 9.1 million units, a 1.7 percent increase over the same period in 1995," the OICA said in a statement.
Car exports rose 1.6 percent to 7.6 million.
